title: Times Now Live As Maharashtra Votes In India's Richest Civic Body Polls With Focus On Mumbai BMC
text: Times Now Live As Maharashtra Votes In India’s Richest Civic Body Polls With Focus On Mumbai BMCTimes Now is bringing live coverage from Mumbai as voting is underway today in Maharashtra’s civic body elections. Polls are being held across 29 municipal corporations, including the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation, India’s richest civic body. After weeks of intense campaigning and a sharp war of words among political rivals, the contest has now shifted to voters, who are exercising their franchise to decide the next leadership of the BMC.
